core.description: Fast local confidence gates required before recommending merge.

model.description: Core gates plus optional ONNX/model gates when local dependencies are available.

gates.description: Validate registered local dataset contracts before build/replay gates.
gates.success_criteria: All selected registered datasets exist locally, match required columns, pass numeric/quote checks, and produce causal walk-forward windows.

gates.description: Validate registered volatility strategies and render the strategy catalog.
gates.success_criteria: Strategy ids are unique, required fields are present, family coverage is broad enough, and at least one tradable strategy and one component backlog item exist.

gates.description: Validate rough-vol research gates and candidate research backlog.
gates.success_criteria: Research gates have unique ids, evidence outputs for non-candidates, at least one pass, one rejected negative control, and one candidate backlog item.

gates.description: Configure the demo CMake build directory.
gates.success_criteria: CMake exits 0, build files are generated, and core gates do not depend on ONNX Runtime.

gates.description: Exercise accepted, partial, filled, and rejected execution lifecycle paths.
Run unit tests for schedule generation, gates, promotion/archive, and manifest writing.
Replay the current two-day local SPY window with BS delta and write daily CSV.
gates.success_criteria: Replay exits 0 and writes a non-empty daily PnL CSV.

gates.description: Run the unified lab experiment orchestrator in smoke mode.
gates.success_criteria: Experiment writes manifest.json, summary.json, summary.md, validates registries, builds alpha_runner, and replays BS daily PnL.

gates.description: Detect whether local ONNX Runtime headers/libs and neural artifacts are available.
gates.success_criteria: Optional model gates may run only when dependencies and artifacts are present.

gates.description: Replay the same two-day local SPY window with neural BSDE hedger.
gates.success_criteria: Replay exits 0 and writes a finite non-empty daily PnL CSV.

gates.description: Reconfigure the demo build with BUILD_ONNX_DEMO=ON when local ONNX Runtime is available.
gates.success_criteria: CMake exits 0 and finds ONNX Runtime.

gates.description: Build alpha_runner with ONNX Runtime linked.
Run the walk-forward retraining pipeline in smoke/no-promote mode.
gates.success_criteria: Pipeline exits 0 and writes manifest, summary.json, and summary.md.
